title: FlashScript: Compiling Recurring Agent Workflows into Reusable Neuro-Symbolic Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many agent tasks recur with new data or small changes, yet agents regenerate their reasoning and actions on each run, producing different results. Distilling a prior run into a skill helps the agent avoid earlier mistakes, but it still re-runs the full process each time, so runs can vary and incur that cost. We compile a successful agent run into a reusable neuro-symbolic program (NSP) with a set of guidelines we call FlashScript. Actions and data transformations become code, instance-specific values become parameters, and decisions that need model judgment become LLM calls. We identify three layers where these calls belong and three techniques that replace most of them with code. The compilation does not remove nondeterminism; it localizes it, so the deterministic program and its neural calls can be reviewed and tested separately. Across 120 WorkBench analytics tasks with Claude Haiku 4.5, the NSPs were correct and made identical tool

translated_title: FlashScript：将重复出现的智能体工作流编译为可复用的神经符号程序
translated_abstract: 许多智能体任务会随着新数据或微小变化而重复出现，然而智能体在每次运行时都会重新生成推理和动作，产生不一致的结果。将先前的运行提炼成技能虽然能帮助智能体避免之前的错误，但每次仍需重新执行完整流程，导致运行结果多变并产生相应成本。我们提出一套称为 FlashScript 的准则，将成功的智能体运行编译为可复用的神经符号程序（NSP）：动作和数据转换变成代码，特定实例的值变成参数，而需要模型判断的决策变成 LLM 调用。我们识别出这些调用所属的三个层次，以及三种用代码替代其中大部分调用的技术。这种编译并未消除非确定性，而是将其局部化，使确定性程序与神经调用能够被分别审查和测试。在使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 于 120 个 WorkBench 分析任务上的实验中，这些 NSP 表现正确并做出了相同的工具调用（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FlashScript 提出一套将成功的智能体运行编译为可复用神经符号程序的准则——把动作与数据转换变为代码、实例特定值变为参数、需模型判断的决策变为局部化的 LLM 调用——从而将非确定性局部化，使确定性程序与神经调用可分别审查和测试，显著降低重复任务的成本与结果波动。
